Name: (CP) Elliott to Hua Cheng from TGCF
Author: mustardormayo
Description:
[center]༻    Hello!    ༺
[list=1]

[/list]This is a mod that turns Elliott's sprite and portrait models into Hua Cheng from TGCF. It also has a few dialogue changes and is not compatible with any dialogue mods unless it is removed from the code. [/center]
[b]Requirements[/b]: 
  -[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
  -[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[b]
Recommended Mods[/b]: 
[b]  [/b]-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url]

✧ This mod does not change any of the villager's names, so it is HEAVILY recommended to use the above mod to do so. 
✧ This mod is not compatible with any sprite or portrait mods. If you would like to use these, you would need to remove the line of code regarding Elliott from the other mod. 

[center]To install, you will need to uncompress the .zip folder and place it in the 'mods' folder created by SMAPI. [/center]

Manifest.Description: Turned Elliot into Hua Cheng from TGCF.
